KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p491#2/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p491#2/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p491#2/r5.claim: A reading uses the active participles خالق and باث, as predicates of an omitted subject, هو.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p491#2/r5.anchor: وهذا المعنى مطابق لمعاني السورة وقرىء ( وخالق منها زوجها وباث منهما ) بلفظ اسم الفاعل وهو خبر مبتدأ محذوف تقديره وهو خالق

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r1.claim: تساءلون derives from تتساءلون, with the tāʾ assimilated into the sīn; another reading drops the second tāʾ.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r1.anchor: تتساءلون به فأدغمت التاء في السين وقرىء ( تساءلون ) بطرح التاء الثانية

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r2.claim: The expression can mean asking one another by God and kinship as an appeal, or invoking them to ask another person; the tafaʿal form can serve for plural tafʿal.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r2.anchor: أي يسأل بعضكم بعضا بالله وبالرحم فيقول بالله وبالرحم أفعل كذا على سبيل الاستعطاف وأناشدك الله والرحم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿud's reading تسلون supports the interpretation that people ask others by God and kinship.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r3.anchor: وتنصره قراءة من قرأ ( تسلون به ) مهموز أو غير مهموز

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r4.claim: The accusative reading of والأرحام may coordinate either with the command to fear God or with the grammatical object of the prepositional phrase; Ibn Masʿud's reading explicitly repeats the preposition.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r4.anchor: وقرىء ( والأرحام ) بالحركات الثلاث فالنصب على وجهين إما على واتقوا الله والأرحام أو ان يعطف على محل الجار والمجرور

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r5.claim: The genitive reading that coordinates the explicit noun with the attached pronoun is unsound because the pronoun and preposition are too tightly joined; repeating the preposition is required.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r5.anchor: والجر على عطف الظاهر على المضمر وليس بسديد لأن الضمير المتصل متصل كاسمه والجار والمجرور كشيء واحد

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r6.claim: Those defending the genitive reading posit a repeated preposition, with a line of poetry as a parallel.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r6.anchor: وقد تمحل لصحة هذه القراءة بأنها على تقدير تكرير الجار ونظيرها ( فاذهب فما بك والأيام من عجب )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r7.claim: With nominative case, kinship is a subject with an omitted predicate: it too is to be guarded or invoked in requests.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r7.anchor: والرفع على أنه مبتدأ خبره محذوف كأنه قيل والأرحام كذلك على معنى والأرحام مما يتقى

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r8.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r8.claim: People acknowledged a creator and invoked God and kinship in requests; they are told to fear God, honor these appeals, and not sever family ties.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r8.anchor: والمعنى أنهم كانوا يقرون بأن لهم خالقا وكانوا يتساءلون بذكر الله والرحم فقيل لهم اتقوا الله الذي خلقكم واتقوا الذي تتناشدون به

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r9.claim: Mentioning kinship alongside God signals its special importance, as Qur'an 17:23 also pairs worship of God with kindness to parents.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r9.anchor: وقد آذن عز وجل إذ قرن الأرحام باسمه أن صلتها منه بمكان كما قال ^ أن لا تعبدوا الا اياه وبالوالدين إحسانا ^ الإسراء

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r10.speaker: الحسن
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r10.claim: Al-Hasan says to grant what is requested when someone appeals to God or to family ties.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r10.anchor: وعن الحسن إذا سألك بالله فأعطه وإذا سألك بالرحم فأعطه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas reports that kinship hangs from the Throne and greets and speaks to the one who maintains it.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p492/r11.anchor: ما روي عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنه الرحم معلقة بالعرش فإذا أتاها الواصل بشت به وكلمته

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r1.claim: The continuing account of kinship says it veils itself from the person who severs family ties.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r2.speaker: النبي
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r2.claim: The Prophet's saying urges people to choose carefully for their offspring.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r2.anchor: وسئل ابن عيينة عن قوله عليه الصلاة والسلام 250 ( تخيروا لنطفكم )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r3.speaker: ابن عيينة
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r3.claim: Asked about the Prophetic saying, Ibn ʿUyayna explains that it concerns one's children and placing them in a lawful setting.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r3.anchor: وسئل ابن عيينة عن قوله عليه الصلاة والسلام 250 ( تخيروا لنطفكم ) + + فقال يقول لأولادكم وذلك ان يضع ولده في الحلال

KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r4.claim: The first act of maintaining kinship is choosing a lawful place for conception; one should preserve lineage, seek health, and avoid debauchery rather than follow unguided desire.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v1p493/r4.anchor: وأول صلته أن يختار له الموضع الحلال فلا يقطع رحمه ولا نسبه فإنما للعاهر الحجر ثم يختار الصحة ويجتنب الدعر ولا يضعه موضع سوء

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r1.claim: The one soul is Adam; this origin is a favor because common descent should bring people closer to mutual affection.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r1.anchor: يعني آدم , وفي ذلك نعمة عليكم لأنه أقرب إلى التعاطف بينكم .

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, and al-Hasan say Eve was created from Adam's rib.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس , ومجاهد , والحسن خلقت من ضلع آدم

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r3.claim: One view specifies the left rib, which explains the saying that woman is a crooked rib.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r3.anchor: وقيل الأيسر , ولذلك قيل للمرأة : ضلع أعوج .

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r4.speaker: النبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r4.claim: A report from the Prophet at the verse's revelation says woman was created from man, whose concern is woman, while man's concern is clay.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r4.anchor: روي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال عند نزولها عليه :

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r5.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r5.claim: Mujahid and Ibrahim understand asking through God and kinship as the formula “I ask you by God and by kin”; Hamza reads al-arham in the genitive on this interpretation.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r5.anchor: وهذا قول مجاهد وإبراهيم , وقرأ حمزة والأرحام بالكسر على هذا المعنى .

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r6.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r6.claim: Qatada and al-Suddi instead read the phrase as a command to maintain kinship and not sever it; the opening's common origin means people are siblings, even when distant.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r6.anchor: أنه أراد صلوها ولا تقطعوها , وهو قول قتادة , والسدي

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r7.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r7.claim: Mujahid explains raqib as a guardian or preserver.

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r8.speaker: ابن زيد
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r8.claim: Ibn Zayd explains raqib as knowing or all-aware.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p446#2/r8.anchor: والثاني : عليما , وهو قول ابن زيد .

MUJAHID:v1p143/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p143/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p143/r1.claim: The one soul is Adam, and Eve was created from Adam's short rib while he slept.
MUJAHID:v1p143/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله ﴿ الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة ﴾ يعني من آدم ﴿ وخلق منها زوجها ﴾ يقول خلق حواء من قصيري آدم

MUJAHID:v1p143/r2.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p143/r2.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p143/r2.claim: When Adam woke, he called her a woman, using the Nabataean word athā.
MUJAHID:v1p143/r2.anchor: فاستيقظ فقال أثا يعني امرأة وهي بالنبطية

MUQATIL:4:1/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r1.claim: The command to fear the Lord is a warning, meaning they should fear Him; the one soul is Adam.
MUQATIL:4:1/r1.anchor: يخوفهم، يقول: اخشوا ربكم { الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة } ، يعنى آدم

MUQATIL:4:1/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r2.claim: Adam's spouse Eve was made from his rib and named Hawwa because she was created from the living Adam.
MUQATIL:4:1/r2.anchor: من نفس آدم من ضلعه حواء، وإنما سميت حواء لأنها خلقت من حى آدم

MUQATIL:4:1/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r3.claim: God produced many men and women from Adam and Eve, amounting to a thousand communities.
MUQATIL:4:1/r3.anchor: وخلق من آدم وحواء رجالا كثيرا ونساء، هم ألف أمة

MUQATIL:4:1/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r4.claim: People ask one another by God about one another's rights and needs.
MUQATIL:4:1/r4.anchor: تسألون بالله بعضكم ببعض الحقوق والحوائج

MUQATIL:4:1/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r5.claim: They must fear severing kin ties and instead maintain them.

MUQATIL:4:1/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:4:1/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:4:1/r6.claim: God watches over them as the preserver of their deeds.
MUQATIL:4:1/r6.anchor: إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا } [آية: 1]، يعنى حفيظا لأعمالكم

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r1.claim: The address to people means the children of Adam.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r1.anchor: ﴿ يا أيها الناس ﴾ يا بنى آدم

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r2.claim: The one soul is Adam, the common origin from which God brought humankind forth.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r2.anchor: فرعكم من أصل واحد وهو نفس آدم أبيكم

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r3.claim: The syntax implies that God first brought the one soul into being, then created its spouse from it; Eve was created from one of Adam's ribs.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r3.anchor: معطوف على محذوف كأنه قيل من نفس واحدة أنشأها وخلق منها زوجها

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r4.claim: God spread the two human sexes from Adam and Eve, detailing how humanity was created from them.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r4.anchor: ﴿ وبث منهما ﴾ ونشر من آدم وحواء ﴿ رجالا كثيرا ونساء ﴾ كثيرة

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r5.claim: The address concerns those to whom the Messenger was sent: their origin is Adam and Eve, and countless earlier peoples also descended from them.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r5.anchor: والخطاب فى يا أيها الناس للذين بعث اليهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم والمعنى خلقكم من نفس آدم وخلق منها امكم حواء وبث منهما رجالا كثيرا ونساء غيركم من الأمم الفائتة للحصر

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r6.claim: Mentioning creation after the command to fear God is fitting because the creation displays God's immense power, including power to punish unbelievers, and reflection on it should instill fear.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r6.anchor: لأن ذلك مما يدل على القدرة العظيمة ومن قدر على نحوه كان قادرا على كل شيء ومن المقدورات عقاب الكفار والفجار فالنظر فيه يؤدى إلى أن يتقى القادر عليه ويخشى عقابه

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r7.claim: Creation is also an overwhelming favor, so people owe God fear and must not be ungrateful for it.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r7.anchor: النعمة السابغة عليهم فحقهم أن يتقوه فى كفرانها

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r8.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r8.claim: At the verse's revelation, the Prophet said woman was created from man and is concerned with man, while man was created from earth and is concerned with earth.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r8.anchor: قال عليه السلام عند نزول الآية خلقت المرأة من الرجل فهمها فى الرجل وخلق الرجل من التراب فهمه فى التراب

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r9.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r9.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r9.claim: The underlying form is tatasāʾalūn; the first tāʾ assimilates into sīn after being changed to sīn because the sounds are close and both unvoiced.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r9.anchor: والأصل تتساءلون فأدغمت التاء فى السين بعد إبدالها سينا لقرب التاء من السين للهمس

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r10.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r10.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r10.claim: Kufan readers use the lightened tasāʾalūn form by dropping the second tāʾ to avoid two consecutive tāʾs.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r10.anchor: تساءلون به بالتخفيف كوفى على حذف التاء الثانية استثقالا لاجتماع التاءين

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r11.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r11.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r11.claim: People ask one another by God and by kinship, appealing for a favor.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r11.anchor: أى يسأل بعصكم بعضا بالله وبالرحم أفعل كذا

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r12.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r12.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r12.claim: Al-arḥām may be accusative, coordinated with God's name or with the syntactic position of the prepositional phrase, meaning people must not sever kinship ties.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r12.anchor: ﴿ والأرحام ﴾ بالنصب على أنه معطوف على اسم الله تعالى

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r13.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r13.speaker: حمزة
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r13.claim: Ḥamza reads al-arḥām in the genitive, coordinating the explicit noun with the attached pronoun; Nasafi calls this weak because the pronoun and prepositional phrase are tightly connected.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r13.anchor: أو بالجر حمزة على عطف الظاهر على الضمير وهو ضعيف لأن الضمير المتصل كاسمه متصل والجار والمجرور كسئ واحد

NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r14.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r14.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r14.claim: Raqīb means either guardian or one who knows.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p201#2/r14.anchor: ﴿ إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا ﴾ حافظا أو عالما

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r1.claim: The derivations and meanings of الناس, التقوى, الرب, creation, spouse, and spreading were already treated in al-Baqara and are not repeated here.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r1.anchor: قد مضى في «البقرة» اشتقاق { الناس } ومعنى التقوى والرب والخلق والزوج والبث، فلا معنى للإعادة.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r2.claim: The verse points to the Creator.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r3.claim: The feminine form واحدة follows the grammatical gender of نفس; masculine واحد is also possible when following its intended meaning, Adam.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r3.anchor: وقال { واحدة } على تأنيث لفظ النفس. ولفظ النفس يؤنث وإن عني به مذكر. ويجوز في الكلام { من نفس واحد }

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r4.speaker: مجاهد، قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r4.claim: Mujahid and Qatada identify the single soul as Adam.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r4.anchor: وهذا على مراعاة المعنى إذ المراد بالنفس آدم عليه السلام قاله مجاهد وقتادة.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r5.speaker: ابن أبي عبلة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r5.claim: Ibn Abi Ablah reads واحد without the feminine ending.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r5.anchor: وهي قراءة ابن أبي عبلة «واحد» بغير هاء.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r6.claim: بث means to disperse and spread throughout the earth; Qurtubi cites 88:16 as an example of the word.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r6.anchor: { وبث } معناه فرق ونشر في الأرض ومنه وزرابي مبثوثة

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r7.claim: منهما refers to Adam and Eve.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r8.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r8.claim: Mujahid says Eve was created from Adam's قصيري (a rib of his side).
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r8.anchor: قال مجاهد: خلقت حواء من قصيري آدم.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r9.claim: A prophetic report says woman was created from a curved rib; Qurtubi notes that this report was discussed earlier in al-Baqara.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r10.claim: The verse confines Adam and Eve's descendants to male and female kinds; an intersex person is not a separate kind but belongs to one of them as human, with classification by bodily deficiencies and additions discussed earlier in al-Baqara.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r10.anchor: حصر ذريتهما في نوعين فاقتضى أن الخنثى ليس بنوع، لكن له حقيقة

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r11.claim: Repeating the command to fear God reinforces it and calls the hearers' attention to it.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r11.anchor: الثانية قوله تعالى: { واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به والأرحام } كرر الاتقاء تأكيدا

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r12.claim: الذي is grammatically an accusative adjective, and الأرحام is coordinated; the command means fear disobeying God and fear severing kinship ties.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r12.anchor: و «الذي» في موضع نصب على النعت. «والأرحام» معطوف. أي اتقوا الله أن تعصوه. واتقوا الأرحام أن تقطعوها.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r13.speaker: أهل المدينة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r13.claim: The Medinese readers assimilate the tā’ into the sīn in تساءلون.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r13.anchor: وقرأ أهل المدينة «تساءلون» بإدغام التاء في السين.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r14.speaker: أهل الكوفة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r14.claim: The Kufans delete one of the two adjacent tā’s and lighten the sīn because the meaning remains clear, as in ولا تعاونوا and تنزل.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r15.speaker: إبراهيم النخعي، قتادة، الأعمش، حمزة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r15.claim: Ibrahim al-Nakha'i, Qatada, al-A'mash, and Hamza read والأرحام with genitive inflection.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r15.anchor: وقرأ إبراهيم النخعي وقتادة والأعمش وحمزة { والأرحام } بالخفض.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r16.speaker: البصريون
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r16.claim: The leading Basran grammarians call the genitive reading solecistic and say it is impermissible.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r16.anchor: فأما البصريون فقال رؤساؤهم: هو لحن لا تحل القراءة به.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r17.speaker: الكوفيون
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r17.claim: The Kufans call the genitive reading ugly but offer no explanation for its ugliness.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r17.anchor: وأما الكوفيون فقالوا: هو قبيح ولم يزيدوا على هذا ولم يذكروا علة قبحه

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r18.speaker: سيبويه
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r18.claim: Sibawayh rejects coordinating a noun with a genitive pronoun because the pronoun is like tanwīn, which cannot itself be coordinated.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r18.anchor: وقال سيبويه: لم يعطف على المضمر المخفوض لأنه بمنزلة التنوين، والتنوين لا يعطف عليه.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r19.speaker: الحسن، النخعي، مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r19.claim: Another group says الأرحام is coordinated with the pronoun because people would appeal to one another by God and kinship; these authorities explain it this way, which Qurtubi later calls correct.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r19.anchor: وقال جماعة: هو معطوف على المكني فإنهم كانوا يتساءلون بها، يقول الرجل: سألتك بالله والرحم

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r20.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r20.claim: Al-Zajjaj and others say coordinating an overt noun with a genitive pronoun is awkward unless the preposition is repeated.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1/r20.anchor: وضعفه أقوام منهم الزجاج، وقالوا: يقبح عطف الاسم الظاهر على المضمر في الخفض إلا بإظهار الخافض

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r1.claim: The objection illustrates its rule with the verse about the earth swallowing Qarun and with the phrase مررت به وزيد.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r1.anchor:
فخسفنا به وبداره الأرض
[القصص: 81] ويقبح «مررت به وزيد» قال الزجاج عن المازني:

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r2.speaker: المازني، الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r2.claim: Al-Mazini's argument, reported by al-Zajjaj, is that conjuncts are partners and each should substitute for the other; because مررت بزيد وبك is not said, neither should مررت بك وزيد.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r2.anchor: قال الزجاج عن المازني: لأن المعطوف والمعطوف عليه شريكان، يحل كل واحد منهما محل صاحبه

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r3.speaker: سيبويه
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r3.claim: Sibawayh considers the construction ugly and acceptable only in poetry, citing a line that coordinates الأيام with the pronoun in بك and another with الكعب after بينها.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r3.anchor: وأما سيبويه فهي عنده قبيحة ولا تجوز إلا في الشعر كما قال: فاليوم قربت تهجونا وتشتمنا

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r4.speaker: أبو علي
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r4.claim: Abu Ali calls the construction weak by analogy.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r4.anchor: وقال أبو علي: ذلك ضعيف في القياس.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r5.speaker: المبرد
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r5.claim: Al-Mubarrad says he would leave prayer behind an imam who recited the genitive form in either this verse or بمصرخي.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r5.anchor: وفي كتاب التذكرة المهدية عن الفارسي أن أبا العباس المبرد قال: لو صليت خلف إمام

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r6.speaker: الزجاج، إسماعيل بن إسحاق
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r6.claim: Al-Zajjaj calls Hamza's reading a grave error in religion because the Prophet forbade swearing by fathers; Ismail b. Ishaq likewise says swearing by anyone besides God is grave and exclusive to God.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r6.anchor: قال الزجاج: قراءة حمزة مع ضعفها وقبحها في العربية خطأ عظيم في أصول أمر الدين

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r7.speaker: النحاس
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r7.claim: Al-Nahhas rejects treating الأرحام as an oath because the prophetic report indicates accusative, and he says the grammar and sense both oppose an oath reading.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r7.anchor: قال النحاس: وقول بعضهم { والأرحام } قسم خطأ من المعنى والإعراب لأن الحديث عن النبي

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r8.speaker: جرير، النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r8.claim: Jarir reports that after needy men from Mudar arrived, the Prophet's face changed, and in his sermon after prayer he recited the verse through الأرحام and urged charity; Qurtubi takes this as evidence for the accusative, exhorting care for kin.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r8.anchor:
عن المنذر بن جرير عن أبيه قال:
" كنا عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم حتى جاء قوم من مضر

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r9.claim: The Prophet says that one who swears should swear by God or remain silent, supporting rejection of an oath by kinship.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#2/r9.anchor:
وأيضا فقد صح عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" من كان حالفا فليحلف بالله أو ليصمت "

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r1.claim: Qurtubi says that the interpretation asking through God's and kinship's authority does not fit the preceding hadith and semantic arguments against a genitive reading.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r1.anchor: فهذا يرد قول من قال: المعنى أسألك بالله وبالرحم.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r2.speaker: أبو إسحاق
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r2.claim: Abu Ishaq interprets تساءلون به as seeking or demanding one's rights through God; Qurtubi says this also gives no basis for genitive case.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r2.anchor: وقد قال أبو إسحاق: معنى { تساءلون به } يعني تطلبون حقوقكم به. ولا معنى للخفض

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r3.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r3.claim: Ibn Atiyya adopts the language scholars' arguments against reading الأرحام in the genitive.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r3.anchor: قلت: هذا ما وقفت عليه من القول لعلماء اللسان في منع قراءة «والأرحام» بالخفض، واختاره ابن عطية.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r4.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r4.claim: Al-Qushayri rejects the grammatical scholars' objection and chooses coordination, arguing that transmitted readings are mutawātir from the Prophet and rejecting one rejects the Prophet; Arabic grammar must be learned from him.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r4.anchor: ورده الإمام أبو النصر عبد الرحيم بن عبد الكريم القشيري، واختار العطف فقال: ومثل هذا الكلام مردود عند أئمة الدين

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r5.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r5.claim: Al-Qushayri says the hadith is open to question: the Prophet once swore by a man's father, and the ban concerns taking an oath by another; invoking the right of kinship is different and not forbidden.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r5.anchor: وأما ما ذكر من الحديث ففيه نظر لأنه عليه السلام قال لأبي العشراء.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r6.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r6.claim: Al-Qushayri also allows an oath interpretation, taking the phrase to mean fear God and the right of kinship, like saying by your father.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r6.anchor: قال القشيري: وقد قيل هذا إقسام بالرحم، أي اتقوا الله وحق الرحم، كما تقول: افعل كذا وحق أبيك.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r7.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r7.claim: Al-Qushayri calls that interpretation strained and lists Quranic oaths by stars, Mount Sinai, the fig, and the Prophet's life as parallels.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r7.anchor: وقد جاء في التنزيل: «والنجم، والطور، والتين، لعمرك» وهذا تكلف.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r8.claim: Qurtubi replies that an oath by kinship is not far-fetched: God may swear by what He chooses and created signs can testify to His oneness and power; Arabs also swear by kinship.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r8.anchor: قلت: لا تكلف فيه فإنه لا يبعد أنه يكون «والأرحام» من هذا القبيل، فيكون أقسم بها كما أقسم

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r9.claim: Another possible analysis supplies an omitted ب before الأرحام, as in a poetic line where genitive case appears without an expressed preposition.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r9.anchor: ويصح أن تكون الباء مرادة فحذفها كما حذفها في قوله: مشائيم ليسوا مصلحين عشيرة ولا ناعب إلا ببين غرابها

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r10.speaker: ابن الدهان أبو محمد سعيد بن مبارك
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r10.claim: Ibn al-Dahhan reports that Kufans permit coordinating an overt noun with a genitive pronoun and gives poetic examples.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#3/r10.anchor: قال آبن الدهان أبو محمد سعيد بن مبارك: والكوفي يجيز عطف الظاهر على المجرور ولا يمنع منه.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r1.claim: Qurtubi adduces further poetic examples used by Kufan grammarians to support overt nouns coordinated with genitive pronouns, including examples with الأيام, الكعب, الضحاك, and الأرض.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r1.anchor: فاذهب فما بك والأيام من عجب

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r2.claim: Some apply the same analysis to 15:20, coordinating من with the pronouns in لكم and فيها.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r2.anchor: وعلى هذا حمل بعضهم قوله تعالى: وجعلنا لكم فيها معايش ومن لستم له برازقين [الحجر: 20] فعطف على الكاف والميم.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r3.speaker: عبد الله بن يزيد
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r3.claim: Abdullah b. Yazid reads والأرحام in nominative as a new subject with an implied predicate that kinship is worthy of being maintained; it may also be an exhortation, since some Arabs raise an object of exhortation.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r3.anchor: وقرأ عبدالله بن يزيد «والأرحام» بالرفع على الابتداء، والخبر مقدر، تقديره:

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r4.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r4.claim: Al-Farra cites a poem as evidence that some Arabs use the nominative in an exhortation.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r4.anchor: يحتمل أن يكون إغراء لأن من العرب من يرفع المغرى. وأنشد الفراء:

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r5.claim: One explanation takes الأرحام in the accusative as coordinated with the syntactic accusative position of به; a poem provides an analogous construction.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r5.anchor: وقد قيل: إن { والأرحام } بالنصب عطف على موضع به لأن موضعه نصب، ومنه قوله:

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r6.claim: The most apparent analysis is an accusative governed by an omitted verb, as Qurtubi explained earlier.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r6.anchor: والأظهر أنه نصب بإضمار فعل كما ذكرنا.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r7.claim: The phrase is also supported by Arabs' saying, I ask you by God and kinship.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r8.claim: All religious communities agree that maintaining kinship ties is obligatory and severing them is forbidden.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r8.anchor: الثالثة اتفقت الملة على أن صلة الرحم واجبة وأن قطيعتها محرمة.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r9.claim: When Asma asked whether to maintain her mother, the Prophet told her to do so, even though her mother was an unbeliever.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r9.anchor: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: قال لأسماء وقد سألته أأصل أمي «نعم صلي أمك»

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r10.speaker: أبو حنيفة وأصحابه
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r10.claim: Because of the sanctity of kinship, Abu Hanifa and his followers say relatives inherit when there is no agnate or fixed-share heir and that a purchased close relative is freed.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r10.anchor: حتى انتهى الحال بأبي حنيفة وأصحابه فقالوا بتوارث ذوي الأرحام إن لم يكن عصبة ولا فرض مسمى

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r11.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، أبو داود
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r11.claim: They support automatic emancipation with the report transmitted by Abu Dawud that whoever owns a close blood relative has freed them.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r11.anchor: وعضدوا ذلك بما رواه أبو داود أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r12.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب، عبد الله بن مسعود، الحسن البصري، جابر بن زيد، عطاء، الشعبي، الزهري، الثوري، أحمد، إسحاق
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r12.claim: The view is also attributed to Umar, Ibn Masud, and numerous Successors and later jurists; Qurtubi knows no Companion who opposed Umar and Ibn Masud on it.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r12.anchor: وهو قول أكثر أهل العلم. روي ذلك عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه وعبدالله بن مسعود، ولا يعرف لهما مخالف من الصحابة.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r13.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r13.claim: Qurtubi says Maliki scholars have three opinions on the hadith's scope; the first restricts it to parents and grandparents.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#4/r13.anchor: ولعلمائنا في ذلك ثلاثة أقوال: الأول أنه مخصوص بالآباء والأجداد.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r1.claim: A second interpretation takes the two wings to mean brothers; the next interpretation corresponds to Abu Hanifa’s position.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r1.anchor: الثاني الجناحان يعني الأخوة. الثالث كقول أبي حنيفة.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r2.claim: Al-Shafiʿi says ownership emancipates only one’s children, parents, and mothers, not siblings or other kin.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r2.anchor: وقال الشافعي: لا يعتق عليه إلا أولاده وآباؤه وأمهاته، ولا يعتق عليه إخوته

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r3.claim: Qurtubi prefers the first position because of the transmitted report that a person who owns a prohibited close relative frees them.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r3.anchor: والصحيح الأول للحديث الذي ذكرناه وأخرجه الترمذي والنسائي

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r4.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports the Prophet’s rule that owning a close relative who is unmarriageable makes that relative free.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r4.anchor: من ملك ذا رحم محرم فقد عتق عليه

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r5.claim: Although al-Nasaʾi called the report munkar and others noted Dhimra alone transmitted it, Qurtubi says a trustworthy transmitter’s singular report is not impaired by that alone.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r5.anchor: هذا حديث منكر. وقال غيره: تفرد به ضمرة. وهذا هو معنى المنكر والشاذ في اصطلاح المحدثين. وضمرة عدل ثقة، وانفراد الثقة بالحديث لا يضره.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r6.speaker: أكثر أهل العلم; شريك القاضي
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r6.claim: Most scholars exclude milk relatives from the emancipation report’s scope, while Sharik al-Qadi says they are freed.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r6.anchor: فقال أكثر أهل العلم لا يدخلون في مقتضى الحديث. وقال شريك القاضي بعتقهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r7.speaker: أهل الظاهر وبعض المتكلمين
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r7.claim: The literalists and some theologians argue that a son does not free his father merely by buying him, since purchase establishes ownership and its rights.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r7.anchor: وذهب أهل الظاهر وبعض المتكلمين إلى أن الأب لا يعتق على الابن إذا ملكه واحتجوا بقوله عليه السلام

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r8.claim: Qurtubi rejects that argument: retaining one’s father in one’s ownership is not dutiful kindness, and the son must free him under the report or the command to treat parents well.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r8.anchor: وهذا جهل منهم بمقاصد الشرع فإن الله تعالى يقول: وبالوالدين إحسانا

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r9.claim: The majority understand the purchase report figuratively: because the child caused his father’s freedom by buying him, the law attributes the emancipation to the child.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r9.anchor: ومعنى الحديث عند الجمهور أن الولد لما تسبب إلى عتق أبيه باشترائه نسب الشرع العتق إليه نسبة الإيقاع منه.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r10.claim: The first position follows the scripture and Sunna; the second extends the father’s rule to close prohibited kin such as a son and brother; the third rests on Dhimra’s report.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r10.anchor: فوجه القول الأول ما ذكرناه من معنى الكتاب والسنة، ووجه الثاني إلحاق القرابة القريبة المحرمة بالأب المذكور في الحديث

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r11.claim: Al-arham means all relatives, whether they are unmarriageable kin or not.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r11.anchor: الرحم اسم لكافة الأقارب من غير فرق بين المحرم وغيره.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r12.speaker: أبو حنيفة
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r12.claim: Abu Hanifa treats unmarriageable kinship as the relevant tie barring retraction of a gift, so cousins may be excluded despite kinship and inheritance ties.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r12.anchor: وأبو حنيفة يعتبر الرحم المحرم في منع الرجوع في الهبة

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r13.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r13.claim: Qurtubi rejects requiring unmarriageable kinship as an unsupported addition to the verse, especially since it permits severing relations with cousins.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r13.anchor: فاعتبار المحرم زيادة على نص الكتاب من غير مستند

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r14.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r14.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas and Mujahid gloss raqīb as a guardian or keeper; Ibn Zayd glosses it as knowing.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r14.anchor: أي حفيظا عن ابن عباس ومجاهد. ابن زيد: عليما.

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r15.claim: Qurtubi explains raqīb as a divine attribute meaning keeper or watcher, and notes its sense of waiting and watching.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r15.anchor: وقيل: { رقيبا } حافظا قيل: بمعنى فاعل. فالرقيب من صفات الله تعالى، والرقيب الحافظ والمنتظر

QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r16.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r16.claim: The related forms also refer to a high lookout, the third archery arrow with a share, and a kind of snake, making raqīb a polysemous word.
QURTUBI-FULL:4:1#5/r16.anchor: والمرقب: المكان العالي المشرف، يقف عليه الرقيب. والرقيب: السهم الثالث من السبعة التي لها أنصباء. ويقال: إن الرقيب ضرب من الحيات

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r1.claim: The surah centers on duties of compassion and rights toward children, women, and orphans, returns to this theme at its end, and also prescribes purification, prayer, and fighting; its burdensome duties open by grounding taqwa in God's creation.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r1.anchor: هذه السورة مشتملة على أنواع كثيرة من التكاليف ، وذلك لأنه تعالى أمر الناس

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas, as transmitted by al-Wahidi, takes the address يا أيها الناس to refer to the people of Mecca.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r2.anchor: روى الواحدي عن ابن عباس في قوله : { يذهبكم أيها الناس } أن هذا الخطاب لأهل

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r3.claim: The usul exegetes hold, correctly in the author's view, that the address is general to all legally responsible people.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r3.anchor: الأصوليون من المفسرين فقد اتفقوا على أن الخطاب عام لجميع المكلفين ، وهذا هو الأصح

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r4.claim: The definite plural الناس denotes all people, supporting the general address.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r4.anchor: أن لفظ الناس جمع دخله الألف واللام فيفيد الاستغراق

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r5.claim: The command to fear God is justified by creation from one soul, a rationale shared by all humanity descended from Adam.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r5.anchor: أنه تعالى علل الأمر بالاتقاء بكونه تعالى خالقا لهم من نفس واحدة

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r6.claim: Taqwa is required of everyone worldwide, not only Meccans, reinforcing the universal scope of the address and its rationale.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r6.anchor: أن التكليف بالتقوى غير مختص بأهل مكة ، بل هو عام في حق جميع العالمين

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas argues that the final clause addresses Arabs because appealing by God and kinship was their custom, so the opening shares that audience.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r7.anchor: وحجة ابن عباس أن قوله : { واتقوا الله الذى تساءلون به والارحام } مختص بالعرب

RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r8.claim: The author answers that a specific audience in the verse's ending does not prevent its opening from addressing everyone; the last clause may be Arab-specific.
RAZI-FULL:v9p128/r8.anchor: ثبت في أصول الفقه أن خصوص آخر الآية لا يمنع من عموم أولها

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r1.claim: The opening of al-Nisa is the fourth surah in the Quran's first half, while al-Hajj is fourth in the second half; their openings establish knowledge of creation and resurrection respectively, with creation placed first.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r1.anchor: إحداهما : هذه السورة وهي السورة الرابعة من النصف الاول من القرآن . والثانية : سورة الحج

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r2.claim: The command to fear God is connected to both the fact that God created humanity and the particular way He created it from one soul.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r2.anchor: قولنا إنه تعالى خلقنا من نفس واحدة ، مشتمل على قيدين

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r3.claim: Because God created our beings and attributes, He is our master and we His servants; lordship entails obedience to His commands and servitude entails submission.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r3.anchor: لما كان خالقا لنا وموجدا لذواتنا وصفاتنا فنحن عبيده وهو مولى لنا

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r4.claim: Creation is the utmost beneficence: God brought people from nonexistence to existence, revived them, empowered them, and taught them, so they owe humility and obedience.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r4.anchor: فانك كنت معدوما فأوجدك ، وميتا فأحياك ، وعاجزا فأقدرك . وجاهلا فعلمك

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r5.claim: God's blessings require humility, submission, and abandoning rebellion, as the verse about being dead and then made alive also says.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r5.anchor: فلما كانت النعم بأسرها من الله سبحانه وجب على العبد أن يقابل تلك النعم

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r6.claim: Since God alone is creator, deity, and lord, people must worship Him and avoid His prohibitions.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r6.anchor: وجب علينا أن نشتغل بعبوديته وأن نتقي كل ما نهى عنه وزجر عنه

RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r7.claim: No obedience independently earns reward: the capacity and motive to obey come from God, making obedience itself a divine blessing rather than payment owed to the servant.
RAZI-FULL:v9p129/r7.anchor: فعل الطاعات لا يحصل إلا إذا خلق الله القدرة على الطاعة ، وخلق الداعية على الطاعة

RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r1.claim: Humanity's descent from one person yields people of diverse colors, appearances, and builds, showing a freely acting creator rather than an influencing nature, and warrants obedience to His commands.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r1.anchor: فلما رأينا في أشخاص الناس الأبيض والأسود والأحمر والأسمر والحسن والقبيح والطويل والقصير

RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r2.claim: Shared origin from one soul should increase compassion among people, especially toward orphans, women, and the weak, because kinship creates intimacy and affection.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r2.anchor: فالفائدة في ذكر هذا المعنى أن يصير ذلك سببا لزيادة شفقة الخلق بعضهم على البعض

RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r3.claim: The Prophet says Fatima is a part of him and whatever harms her harms him, illustrating the affection created by kinship.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r3.anchor: وقال عليه الصلاة والسلام : ( فاطمة بضعة مني يؤذيني ما يؤذيها )

RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r4.claim: Recognizing that everyone descends from one person should end boasting and arrogance and produce humility and good character.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r4.anchor: أن الناس اذا عرفوا كون الكل من شخص واحد تركوا المفاخرة والتكبر

RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r5.claim: The creation of diverse people from one person's loins and a drop of semen also proves resurrection: raising the dead should be no harder for God.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130/r5.anchor: فكيف يستبعد إحياء الأموات وبعثهم ونشورهم ، فتكون الآية دالة على المعاد

RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r1.speaker: الأصم
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r1.claim: Al-Asamm says reason alone cannot show that humans had to descend from one soul; since an unlettered Prophet reported this unseen fact without a teacher, it proves prophecy, while خلقكم indicates knowledge of divine unity.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r1.anchor: قال الأصم : الفائدة فيه : أن العقل لا دليل فيه على أن الخلق يجب أن يكونوا مخلوقين من نفس واحدة

RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r2.claim: Although all people are numerous and Adam was a small beginning, humanity may be attributed to him because Eve came from him and their offspring and descendants followed.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r2.anchor: لأن زوج آدم اذا خلقت من بعضه ، ثم حصل خلق أولاده من نطفتهما ثم كذلك أبدا

RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r3.claim: Muslims agree that the single soul is Adam; its description is grammatically feminine because نفس is feminine, as also in the verse about a pure soul.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r3.anchor: أجمع المسلمون على أن المراد بالنفس الواحدة ههنا هو آدم عليه السلام ، إلا أنه أنث الوصف على لفظ النفس

RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r4.speaker: الشاعر
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r4.claim: An unnamed poet uses the feminine form of خليفة in a line about someone born as successor, offered as a parallel for grammatical agreement with النفس.
RAZI-FULL:v9p130#2/r4.anchor:
وقال الشاعر :
أبوك خليفة ولدته أخرى

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r1.speaker: الأكثرون
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r1.claim: Most exegetes say the spouse is Eve, created from Adam's left rib while he slept; when he awoke he saw and was drawn to her as part of himself.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r1.anchor: وهو الذي عليه الأكثرون أنه لما خلق الله آدم ألقى عليه النوم ، ثم خلق حواء

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r2.claim: A Prophetic report says woman was created from a crooked rib and that straightening it breaks it; leaving it crooked allows enjoyment of her.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r2.anchor: بقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( ان المرأة خلقت من ضلع أعوج فان ذهبت تقيمها كسرتها

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r3.speaker: أبو مسلم الأصفهاني
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r3.claim: Abu Muslim al-Isfahani instead interprets منها as from the same kind, as in verses saying that spouses and a messenger are from among the people themselves.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r3.anchor: والقول الثاني : وهو اختيار أبي مسلم الأصفهاني : أن المراد من قوله : { وخلق منها زوجها } أي من جنسها

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r4.speaker: القاضي
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r4.claim: Al-Qadi prefers the first view because if Eve were independently created, humanity would come from two souls; the author notes that min may instead mark the beginning of creation with Adam.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r4.anchor: قال القاضي : والقول الأول أقوى ، لكي يصح قوله : { خلقكم من نفس واحدة }

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r5.claim: Even if God could create Eve from earth as He created Adam, the author asks what benefit there would be in creating her from Adam's rib.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r5.anchor: فأي فائدة في خلقها من ضلع من أضلاع آدم

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas derives Adam's name from the earth's surface, whose varied colors and qualities are reflected among his descendants.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r6.anchor: قال ابن عباس : إنما سمي آدم بهذا الاسم لأنه تعالى خلقه من أديم الأرض كلها

RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r7.claim: The commentary also explains Hawwa's name by saying that she was created from a living part of Adam, namely a rib.
RAZI-FULL:v9p131/r7.anchor: والمرأة إنما سميت بحواء لأنها خلقت من ضلع من أضلاع آدم فكانت مخلوقة من شيء حي

RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r1.speaker: المتكلمون
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r1.claim: The theologians reject the natural philosophers' claim that creation requires prior material: something either identical to prior matter was not created, or different from it arose from pure nonexistence.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r1.anchor: أجاب المتكلمون فقالوا : خلق الشيء من الشيء محال في العقول

RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r2.speaker: المتكلمون
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r2.claim: They explain من as marking the starting point of creation, not dependence on or need for prior matter.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r2.anchor: وأما كلمة { من } في هذه الآية فهو مفيد ابتداء الغاية ، على معنى أن ابتداء حدوث هذه الأشياء

RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r3.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r3.claim: Al-Kashshaf reports a reading with active participles in وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما, with the implied subject هو خالق.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132/r3.anchor: قال صاحب ( الكشاف ) : قرىء { وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما } بلفظ اسم الفاعل

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r1.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r1.claim: Al-Wahidi explains بث as dispersing and spreading people.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r1.anchor: قال الواحدي : بث منهما : يريد فرق ونشر

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r2.speaker: ابن المظفر
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r2.claim: Ibn al-Muzaffar defines بث as distributing things and illustrates it with spreading horses, hunting dogs, and carpets.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن المظفر : البث تفريقك الأشياء ، يقال : بث الخيل في الغارة

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r3.speaker: الفراء والزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r3.claim: Al-Farraʾ and al-Zajjaj note that some Arabs say أبث الله الخلق for God spread the creation.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r3.anchor: قال الفراء والزجاج : وبعض العرب يقول : أبث الله الخلق

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r4.claim: Saying God spread men and women, rather than spreading men and women from both parents, avoids implying that Adam and Eve themselves were spread from themselves.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r4.anchor: لم يقل : وبث منهما الرجال والنساء لأن ذلك يوجب كونهما مبثوثين عن نفسهما

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r5.claim: Only men are called numerous because their prominence makes their numbers more conspicuous; the wording signals men's visibility and women's concealment.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r5.anchor: شهرة الرجال أتم ، فكانت كثرتهم أظهر ، فلا جرم خصوا بوصف الكثرة

RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r6.claim: Those who say humanity existed as particles in Adam's loins read the spreading literally; opponents understand it as Adam and Eve's offspring and later descendants, attributed to them figuratively.
RAZI-FULL:v9p132#2/r6.anchor: الذين يقولون : إن جميع الأشخاص البشرية كانوا كالذر ، وكانوا مجتمعين في صلب آدم

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r1.claim: Asim, Hamza, and al-Kisa'i read تساءلون in a light form, while the other readers use the doubled form تتساءلون.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r1.anchor: قرأ عاصم وحمزة والكسائي : { تساءلون } بالتخفيف والباقون بالتشديد

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r2.claim: The doubled form assimilates the first t into s because the sounds are close in articulation and both are voiceless; the light form deletes that t to ease adjacent similar letters.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r2.anchor: فمن شدد أراد : تتساءلون فأدغم التاء في السين لاجتماعهما

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r3.speaker: حمزة
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r3.claim: Hamza alone reads الأرحام in the genitive; al-Qaffal says the reading is also transmitted from readers outside the canonical seven, including Mujahid.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r3.anchor: قرأ حمزة وحده { والارحام } بجر الميم قال القفال رحمه الله : وقد رويت هذه القراءة

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r4.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r4.claim: The other readers use the accusative, and al-Kashshaf reports readings of الأرحام in all three case endings.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r4.anchor: وأما الباقون من القراء فكلهم قرؤا بنصب الميم . وقال صاحب ( الكشاف ) : قرىء { والارحام } بالحركات الثلاث

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r5.speaker: أكثر النحويين
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r5.claim: Most grammarians call Hamza's genitive reading unsound because it coordinates an overt noun with a genitive pronoun.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r5.anchor: أما قراءة حمزة فقد ذهب الأكثرون من النحويين إلى أنها فاسدة ، قالوا : لأن هذا يقتضي عطف المظهر على المضمر المجرور

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r6.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r6.claim: Abu Ali al-Farisi argues that a genitive pronoun is particle-like and cannot take an overt coordinated noun.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r6.anchor: قال أبو علي الفارسي : المضمر المجرور بمنزلة الحرف

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r7.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r7.claim: He compares the inseparable pronoun after a preposition to tanwin, which is never detached from its word.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r7.anchor: الأول : أنه لا ينفصل ألبتة كما أن التنوين لا ينفصل

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r8.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r8.claim: He also compares genitive pronouns to the omitted possessive yāʾ in يا غلام, which resembles deletion of tanwin.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r8.anchor: الثاني : أنهم يحذفون الياء من المنادى المضاف في الاختيار كحذفهم التنوين

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r9.speaker: علي بن عيسى
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r9.claim: Ali ibn Isa says overt nouns are not accepted after nominative pronouns either: one says اذهب أنت وزيد, and the genitive pronoun is even less separable.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r9.anchor: وثانيها : قال علي بن عيسى : انهم لم يستحسنوا عطف المظهر على المضمر المرفوع

RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r10.speaker: أبو عثمان المازني
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r10.claim: Abu Uthman al-Mazini says coordination must work in both directions; since مررت بزيدوك is impossible, بك وزيد is also impermissible.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133/r10.anchor: وثالثها : قال أبو عثمان المازني : المعطوف والمعطوف عليه متشاركان

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r1.claim: The author says these grammatical objections cannot outweigh transmitted linguistic usage: Hamza was one of the seven, and the reading is presumed to come from the Prophet, so hearing outweighs weak analogy.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r1.anchor: واعلم أن هذه الوجوه ليست وجوها قوية في دفع الروايات الواردة في اللغات

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r2.claim: One defense of Hamza's genitive reading assumes the preposition is repeated: تساءلون به وبالأرحام.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r2.anchor: أنها على تقدير تكرير الجار ، كأنه قيل تساءلون به وبالارحام

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r3.speaker: سيبويه
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r3.claim: Sibawayh cites an anonymous poem using وما بك والأيام as poetic evidence for the genitive coordination construction.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r3.anchor: وأنشد سيبويه في ذلك : فاليوم قد بت تهجونا وتشتمنا … فاذهب فما بك والأيام من عجب

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r4.speaker: سيبويه
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r4.claim: Sibawayh cites a second anonymous line, وما بينها والكعب, as another poetic precedent for the construction.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r4.anchor: وأنشد أيضا : نعلق في مثل السواري سيوفنا … وما بينها والكعب غوط نفانف

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r5.claim: The author criticizes grammarians for accepting two anonymous poems as evidence while rejecting the readings of Hamza and Mujahid, eminent early Quran scholars.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r5.anchor: والعجب من هؤلاء النحاة أنهم يستحسنون إثبات هذه اللغة بهذين البيتين المجهولين

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r6.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r6.claim: Al-Zajjaj objects that genitive coordination implies swearing by kinship, contrary to the Prophetic ban on swearing by fathers.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r6.anchor: واحتج الزجاج على فساد هذه القراءة من جهة المعنى بقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( لا تحلفوا بآبائكم )

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r7.claim: The author replies that the verse recounts a past Arab practice of appealing by God and kinship, so it does not contradict a later prohibition.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r7.anchor: ويمكن الجواب عنه بأن هذا حكاية عن فعل كانوا يفعلونه في الجاهلية

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r8.claim: The hadith prohibits swearing by fathers, whereas this construction invokes God first and then mentions kinship, so the author sees no conflict.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r8.anchor: وأيضا فالحديث نهي عن الحلف بالآباء فقط ، وههنا ليس كذلك ، بل هو حلف بالله أولا

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r9.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي وعلي بن عيسى
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r9.claim: Their preferred accusative analysis coordinates الأرحام with the syntactic position of the prepositional phrase, as illustrated by poetry.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r9.anchor: الأول : وهو اختيار أبي علي الفارسي وعلي بن عيسى أنه عطف على موضع الجار والمجرور

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r10.speaker: الشاعر
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r10.claim: An unnamed poet's phrase ولا الحديدا is cited as evidence for coordinating the accusative with a prepositional phrase's syntactic position.

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r11.speaker: مجاهد وقتادة والسدي والضحاك وابن زيد والفراء والزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r11.claim: The majority exegetical reading supplies a command to fear kinship by preserving ties and not severing them; the author says it proves severing kinship forbidden and maintaining ties obligatory.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r11.anchor: وهو قول مجاهد وقتادة والسدي والضحاك وابن زيد والفراء والزجاج ، وعلى هذا الوجه

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r12.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r12.claim: Al-Wahidi permits the accusative as an exhortation with an omitted command: preserve and maintain kinship, like the repeated warning الأسد الأسد.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r12.anchor: قال الواحدي رحمه الله : ويجوز أيضا أن يكون منصوبا بالاغراء ، أي والأرحام فاحفظوها وصلوها

RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r13.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r13.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r13.claim: The nominative reading makes الأرحام a subject with an omitted predicate: kinship is also something to protect or something invoked in appeals.
RAZI-FULL:v9p133#2/r13.anchor: الرفع على أنه مبتدأ خبره محذوف كأنه قيل : والأرحام كذلك على معنى والأرحام مما يتقى

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r1.claim: The repeated command to fear God intensifies the exhortation, like repeating ‘hurry’ for emphasis.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r1.anchor: وفي هذا التكرير وجوه : الأول : تأكيد الأمر والحث عليه كقولك للرجل : اعجل اعجل فيكون أبلغ من قولك

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r2.claim: The first command follows God's benefaction in creating people; the second follows their habit of invoking God when requesting things from one another.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r2.anchor: أمر بالتقوى في الأول لمكان الانعام بالخلق وغيره ، وفي الثاني أمر بالتقوى لمكان وقوع التساؤل به فيما يلتمس

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r3.claim: Calling God Rabb evokes nurturing and beneficence, inviting obedience; calling Him Allah evokes majesty and awe, warning against disobedience and punishment.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r3.anchor: والرب لفظ يدل على التربية والاحسان ، والاله لفظ يدل على القهر والهيبة ، فأمرهم بالتقوى بناء على الترغيب

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r4.claim: Asking by God means invoking Him to strengthen a request, appeal, oath, or plea for another's help and support.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r4.anchor: بالله أسألك ، وبالله أشفع اليك ، وبالله أحلف عليك ، إلى غير ذلك مما يؤكد المرء به مراده

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r5.claim: Hamza's genitive reading is clear: Arabs customarily appealed to kinship as well as God, and polytheists even wrote the Prophet invoking both.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r5.anchor: وأما قراءة حمزة فهي ظاهرة من حيث المعنى ، والتقدير : واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به والأرحام

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r6.claim: With the accusative reading, the phrase means ‘fear God and fear kinship,’ understood as maintaining family ties rather than cutting them.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r6.anchor: وأما القراءة بالنصب فالمعنى يرجع إلى ذلك ، والتقدير : واتقوا الله واتقوا الأرحام

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r7.speaker: القاضي
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r7.claim: The Qadi argues that the accusative reading shows one expression can carry different meanings: fearing God means obeying Him, while fearing kin means keeping ties through kindness.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r7.anchor: قال القاضي : وهذا أحد ما يدل على أنه قد يراد باللفظ الواحد المعاني المختلفة

RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r8.claim: He answers that God may have uttered this expression twice, once for each distinct meaning, removing the difficulty.
RAZI-FULL:v9p134/r8.anchor: ويمكن أن يجاب عنه بأنه تعالى لعله تكلم بهذه اللفظة مرتين ، وعلى هذا التقدير يزول الاشكال

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r1.speaker: بعضهم
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r1.claim: Some derive rahim from rahma, meaning benefaction, and explain that kinship prompts people to show mercy to one another; they cite a divine hadith linking the names.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r1.anchor: اسم الرحم مشتق من الرحمة التي هي النعمة ، واحتج بما روي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r2.speaker: آخرون
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r2.claim: Others derive the word rahim from the womb, where benefaction takes place.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r2.anchor: وقال آخرون : بل اسم الرحم مشتق من الرحم الذي عنده يقع الانعام وانه الأصل

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r3.speaker: بعضهم
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r3.claim: A third view makes each of the two words an independent root; al-Razi considers this kind of dispute minor.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r3.anchor: وقال بعضهم : بل كل واحد منهما أصل بنفسه ، والنزاع في مثل هذا قريب

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r4.claim: The verse establishes that it is permissible to ask someone by God.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r4.anchor: دلت الآية على جواز المسألة بالله تعالى

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r5.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r5.claim: Mujahid reports from ʿUmar that the Prophet said to give to anyone who asks by God.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r5.anchor: روى مجاهد عن عمر قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( من سألكم بالله فأعطوه )

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r6.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r6.claim: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib reports that the Prophet ordered seven things, including honoring an oath.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r6.anchor: وعن البراء بن عازب قال : أمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بسبع : منها ابرار القسم

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r7.claim: Mentioning kinship magnifies its rights and reinforces the prohibition on severing it; the cited verses command against cutting ties and enjoin kindness to relatives.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r7.anchor: دل قوله تعالى : { والارحام } على تعظيم حق الرحم وتأكيد النهي عن قطعها

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r8.speaker: قيل
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r8.claim: One reported interpretation takes the term illa in 9:8 to mean kinship.

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r9.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r9.claim: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf reports a divine hadith: God is al-Raḥmān and kinship is al-raḥim; whoever connects it is connected by God, and whoever cuts it is cut off.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r9.anchor: وعن عبد الرحمن بن عوف : أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : ( يقول الله تعالى أنا الرحمن وهي الرحم

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r10.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r10.claim: Abū Hurayra reports that prompt reward follows kinship ties, while prompt punishment follows transgression and a false oath.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r10.anchor: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ( ما من شيء أطيع الله فيه أعجل ثوابا

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r11.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r11.claim: Anas reports that charity and kinship increase lifespan, avert an evil death, and ward off harm and disliked events.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r11.anchor: وعن أنس قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( ان الصدقة وصلة الرحم يزيد الله بهما في العمر

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r12.speaker: النبي
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r12.claim: The Prophet calls giving charity to a hostile relative the best charity; an unnamed interpretation says al-kāshiḥ means an enemy.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r12.anchor: وقال عليه الصلاة والسلام : ( أفضل الصدقة على ذي الرحم الكاشح ) قيل الكاشح العدو

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r13.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r13.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r13.claim: The Qur'an and Sunna establish the duty to maintain kinship and the reward for doing so.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r13.anchor: فثبت بدلالة الكتاب والسنة وجوب صلة الرحم واستحقاق الثواب بها

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r14.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r14.speaker: أصحاب أبي حنيفة
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r14.claim: Hanafi jurists infer that owning a prohibited close relative emancipates that relative: continued service would cause estrangement and sever kinship, which is forbidden.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r14.anchor: أن الرجل اذا ملك ذا رحم محرم عتق عليه مثل الأخ والاخت ، والعم والخال

RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r15.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r15.speaker: أصحاب أبي حنيفة
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r15.claim: Hanafi jurists also hold that a gift to a prohibited close relative cannot be reclaimed, since revocation would cause estrangement and break kinship.
RAZI-FULL:v9p135/r15.anchor: أن الهبة لذي الرحم المحرم لا يجوز الرجوع فيها لان ذلك الرجوع ايحاش يورث قطيعة الرحم

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r1.claim: من نفس is an accusative complement of خلقكم, with من marking the starting point; likewise منها زوجها and بث منهما depend on their respective verbs.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r1.anchor: من نفس }: متعلق ب " خلقكم " فهو في محل نصب. و " من " لابتداء الغاية.

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r2.speaker: ابن أبي عبلة
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r2.claim: Ibn Abi ʿAbla reads واحد without feminine تاء; one explanation agrees with the intended meaning, since نفس refers to Adam.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r2.anchor: وابن أبي عبلة: " واحد " من غير تاء، وله وجهان، أحدهما: مراعاة المعنى

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r3.speaker: ابن أبي عبلة
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r3.claim: A second explanation for the reading واحد is that نفس can be masculine or feminine, supported by a poetic example using ثلاثة أنفس.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r3.anchor: والثاني: أن النفس تذكر وتؤنث، وعليه:

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r4.claim: One parse coordinates وخلق with the semantic sense of واحدة, which implies an action: one soul that was single or separate.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r4.anchor: أحدها: أنه عطف على معنى " واحدة " لما فيه من معنى الفعل كأنه قيل

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r5.claim: The verb وحد يحد and its verbal nouns mean to be alone or separate, clarifying that first coordination.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r5.anchor: يقال: " وحد، يحد، وحدا وحدة " ، بمعنى انفرد

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhshari posits an omitted verb such as created or originated before وخلق, yielding the sense that humankind was branched from one soul.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r6.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " كأنه قيل: من نفس واحدة أنشأها أو ابتدأها وخلق منها

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r7.claim: Al-Zamakhshari and the preceding grammarian posit the omission to preserve the chronological order in which Eve was created before humans.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r7.anchor: وإنما حمل الزمخشري والقائل الذي قبله على ذلك مراعاة الترتيب الوجودي؛ لأن خلق حواء، وهي المعبر عنها بالزوج ، قبل خلقنا

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r8.claim: The author says no such omission is needed, because the conjunction و does not require chronological order.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r8.anchor: ولا حاجة إلى ذلك، لأن الواو لا تقتضي ترتيبا على الصحيح

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r9.claim: A third parse coordinates وخلق with خلقكم inside the relative clause; و is immaterial because it does not impose order.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r9.anchor: الثالث: أنه عطف على " خلقكم " فهو داخل في حيز الصلة، والواو لا يبالى بها، إذ لا تقتضي ترتيبا

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r10.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r10.claim: Al-Zamakhshari limits that direct coordination to an address aimed at the Messenger's contemporaries, who are created from Adam and whose mother Eve was created from him.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r10.anchor: إلا أن الزمخشري خص هذه الوجه بكون الخطاب في { يأيها الناس } لمعاصري الرسول

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r11.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r11.claim: The author questions al-Zamakhshari's apparent restriction of this parsing to contemporaries of the Messenger.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r11.anchor: فظاهر هذا خصوصية الوجه الثاني بكون الخطاب للمعاصرين، وفيه نظر

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r12.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r12.claim: Some supply an implicit جنس, reading منها as from her kind; this belongs to those who say Eve was not created from Adam but from leftover clay, a view the author rejects.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r12.anchor: وقدر بعضهم مضافا في " منها " أي: " من جنسها زوجها " ، وهذا عند من يرى أن حواء لم تخلق من آدم

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r13.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r13.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r13.claim: The view that Eve was created from leftover clay rather than Adam is described as undesirable.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r13.anchor: وإنما خلقت من طينة فضلت من طينة آدم، وهذا قول مرغوب عنه

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r14.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r14.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r14.claim: A reading has وخالق وباث as active participles; al-Zamakhshari parses them as predicates of an omitted subject, meaning he is creator and disperser.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r14.anchor: وقرىء: " وخالق وباث " بلفظ اسم الفاعل. وخرجه الزمخشري على أنه خبر مبتدأ محذوف

SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r15.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r15.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r15.claim: The verbs بث and أبث both mean to disperse, one triliteral and the other quadriliteral.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1/r15.anchor: يقال: بث وأبث بمعنى " فرق " ثلاثيا ورباعيا

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r1.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r1.claim: The more evident parse makes كثيرا an adjective of رجالا; Abu al-Baqa says its masculine form follows the semantic sense of رجال as a number, class, or collective, like masculine verb agreement with a feminine collective.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r1.anchor: أظهرهما: أنه نعت ل " رجالا " قال أبو البقاء: " ولم يؤنثه حملا على المعنى

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r2.claim: The example وقال نسوة shows a masculine verb used with the feminine collective نسوة.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r2.anchor: كما ذكر الفعل المسند إلى جماعة المؤنث كقوله: وقال نسوة

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r3.claim: Alternatively كثيرا modifies an omitted verbal noun: God dispersed them with a great dispersal; Sibawayh treats comparable forms as accusative circumstantial expressions.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r3.anchor: والثاني: أنه نعت لمصدر تقديره: وبث منهما بثا كثيرا. وقد تقدم أن مذهب سيبويه في مثله النصب على الحال

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r4.claim: One answer to why abundance is attached to men alone is that the adjective for women is omitted because the preceding description supplies it: many women.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r4.anchor: أحدهما: أنه حذف صفتهن لدلالة ما قبلها عليها [أي]: ونساء كثيرة

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r5.claim: A second answer is that public prominence suits men, whereas privacy and concealment better suit women.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r5.anchor: والثاني أن الرجال لشهرتهم يناسبهم ذلك بخلاف النساء فإن الأليق بهن الخمول والإخفاء

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r6.claim: The Kufans lighten the سِين by deleting one of the two تاءs for ease; the original is تتساءلون, though grammarians differed over which تاء was deleted.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r6.anchor: قرأ الكوفيون: " تساءلون " بتخفيف السين على حذف إحدى التاءين تخفيفا، والأصل: تتساءلون

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r7.claim: The source notes a prior disagreement about whether the first or second تاء was deleted.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r7.anchor: وقد تقدم لنا الخلاف: هل المحذوف الأولى أو الثانية؟

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r8.claim: Other readers double the سِين by assimilating the تاء of reciprocal form into it because of their close similarity in voicing; ست is cited from سدس.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ الباقون بالتشديد على إدغام تاء التفاعل في السين لأنها مقاربتها في الهمس

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r9.claim: Abdullah reads تسألون from the simple triliteral verb سأل.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r9.anchor: وقرأ عبد الله: " تسألون " من سأل الثلاثي

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r10.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r10.claim: Another reading is تسلون, with the hamza's vowel transferred to the سِين.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r10.anchor: وقرىء " تسلون " بنقل حركة الهمزة على السين

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r11.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r11.claim: The reciprocal form can mean either asking one another or simply فعل; Abdullah's simple-verb reading supports the latter sense.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r11.anchor: و " تساءلون " على التفاعل فيه وجهان، أحدهما: المشاركة في السؤال. والثاني: أنه بمعنى فعل، ويدل عليه قراءة عبد الله

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r12.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r12.claim: Abu al-Baqa explains the preposition on the object by understanding the verb as تتحالفون, since asking itself would take the object directly.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#2/r12.anchor: قال أبو البقاء: " ودخل حرف الجر في المفعول لأن المعنى: تتحالفون " يعني:

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r1.claim: Most readers put والأرحام in the accusative, either coordinating it with God's name to mean respect kinship by not severing it, or supplying an implicit قطع; this is specific under general reverence for God.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r1.anchor: الجمهور/ على نصب ميم " والأرحام " وفيه وجهان، أحدهما: أنه عطف على لفظ الجلالة أي: واتقوا الأرحام أي: لا تقطعوها.

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r2.claim: The author says fearing God means avoiding disobedience, which already includes cutting kinship ties, so this is a specific case under the general command.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r2.anchor: ويقال: " إن هذا في الحقيقة من عطف الخاص على العام، وذلك أن معنى اتقوا الله: اتقوا مخالفته، وقطع الأرحام مندرج فيها "

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r3.claim: The second accusative parse coordinates kinship with the underlying position of the pronoun in به; Abdullah's reading وبالأرحام supports this.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r3.anchor: والثاني: أنه معطوف على محل المجرور في " به " نحو: مررت بزيد وعمرا، لما لم يشركه في الإتباع على اللفظ تبعه على الموضع. ويؤيد هذا قراءة عبد الله: " وبالأرحام "

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r4.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r4.claim: Abu al-Baqa reads the phrase as exalting God and kinship, since swearing by God honors Him.
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r4.anchor: وقال أبو البقاء: " تعظمونه والأرحام، لأن الحلف به تعظيم له "

SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:1#3/r5.speaker: author
